verdict.rationale: Jules exposes a public API to create tasks, send messages, and approve plans (jules-docs-9, jules-docs-12, jules-docs-17), and a community user built a custom MCP bridge to dispatch tasks via the API (jules-comm-19), showing real API-driven parity for core task workflows. However, several UI-surfaced capabilities (repo connection, GitHub label-based triggering, diff browsing, PR creation/merge flows, settings/key management) are documented only as UI or GitHub-integration features with no API equivalent confirmed, and probes for an OpenAPI spec/machine-readable docs all 404 (jules-probe-1/2/3), indicating incomplete or undocumented API surface. Missing for 10: API endpoints/evidence for repo management, diff retrieval, PR merge control, and settings/key admin, plus independent confirmation of full UI-API parity.
